A person who can read and write at least one of four reference languages (national languages, French, English, Arabic) or any other language is considered literate. With the collected data, the population aged 10 years and older can be classified into two categories: literate and illiterate.

Literacy definition: Literacy  is defined as  the ability to read and write with understanding a simple statement of everyday life in any language.  Hence someone who can only write his/her name and not able to write a sentence about his/her everyday life will not be considered literate .
